heading: What the compiler emits
text:
#### What the compiler emits [LCAP.2.1.3]

When all checks pass, the compiler:

1. Loads the sibling `<basename>.dsrt` per [RTCT.4.1].
2. Validates the `[contract]` section against the compiled rule
   network (one entry per alpha/beta/term node, one per series).
3. Computes the canonical contract hash per [RBND.4b].
4. Emits a `RealtimeContract` atom into the DSC carrying the contract values
   and the hash ([RTCT.6.2]).
5. Populates `DscHeader.rt_config_sha256` with the same hash
   ([RDSC.3.8]).
6. Records `realtime` among the program's enabled capabilities in the
   `CapabilityInfo` atom ([RDSC.16.2]).

The DSC consumer (runtime loader) reads the `RealtimeContract` atom directly and
enforces every cap per [RTCT.7]. No integrator-supplied sizing
calls or environment variables participate.
